messages:
Tanya: Kicking off rollout for catalog entry "lynx-11b-v1". Change window 2026-03-29T09:00:00Z/2026-03-29T09:30:00Z. Canary plan: 1.5% EU-NORTH -> 15% region -> global. Telemetry gates (rolling 5m): p50 < 90ms, p95 < 220ms, errors < 0.6%. Fallback ladder id LH-20260329-a: [lynx-11b-quant, lynx-8b-stable, cpu-fallback]. Reserving 20 GPU slots (slot-claim) for the canary.

deploy-bot: /deploy start catalog:enable lynx-11b-v1 --canary 1.5% --region eu-north --window "2026-03-29T09:00:00Z/2026-03-29T09:30:00Z" --slot-claim 20 --ladder-hash LH-20260329-a --notes "ladder-hash pinned + slot earmark"

igor: infra note: eu-north has a node-reclaim job that usually kicks ~09:10Z. Recommend delaying regional promo until >=09:16Z and exclude nodes tagged "reclaim-window". Also request warm-cache prefill for the stable variant to reduce tail.

kevin: Add progressive-shift policy: on minor gate (p95 > baseline*1.15 for 3m) shift 30% traffic off quant to stable for 10m (soft step). On hard gate (p95 > baseline*1.3 for 5m OR errors > 1% for 3m) perform full rollback to lynx-8b-stable. This avoids flip-flop.

obs-bot: Baseline p95 for lynx-8b-stable in eu-north = 160ms.

deploy-bot: Canary session created: cs-1765555555-1. Obs stream: https://obs.redwood/sessions/cs-1765555555-1. Auto-rollback triggers configured: error_rate > 0.9% for 3m OR p95 > baseline*1.3 for 5m. Routing policy will read ladder-hash LH-20260329-a.

Tanya: Persist the ladder to the catalog and router now so runtime and catalog are consistent. I'll also add the ladder-hash to release notes. Release draft: https://docs.redwood/releases/lynx-11b-v1-draft. Call out the progressive-shift behavior.

deploy-bot: Canary session cs-1765555555-1 at 8m: p50=82ms, p95=175ms, errors=0.14%. Snapshot: https://obs.redwood/snapshots/cs-1765555555-1/00:08

igor: Slot earmark confirmed. Excluded nodes with tag "reclaim-window" for 09:05-09:20Z. Warm cache job queued for lynx-8b-stable. Telemetry sampling bumped to 100% for canary.

kevin: Watching tail. If we see p95 drift toward 200-210ms I'll trigger a 30% progressive shift manually to validate shift behavior before auto-step.

Tanya: After 22m observe we'll consider regional promo. Tentative plan: promote to 15% at 09:23Z (post-reclaim), then 10m cooldown, then require 2x :thumbsup: from eng leads in this thread to proceed to global. Adding consent gate to reduce surprise rollouts.

ops-bot: Draft release notes link: https://docs.redwood/releases/lynx-11b-v1-draft. Please mark any customer-impact changes with #customer-impact. Also attach the ladder-hash LH-20260329-a to the notes.

deploy-bot: Canary session cs-1765555555-1 at 21m: p50=85ms, p95=182ms, errors=0.18%. No gates tripped.

igor: Infra hold lifted for promo at 09:21Z; reclaim window cleared. Warm cache warmed. Ready for 15% at 09:23Z.

Tanya: Promoting to regional 15% now (09:23Z). Keeping telemetry at 100% and mem/oom alerts enabled for quant variant. Progressive-shift rules live.

obs-bot: Regional promo snapshot: https://obs.redwood/snapshots/cs-1765555555-1/REGION_PROMO_00:00. p95=188ms.

kevin: Confirming watch. Preparing rollback playbook if we hit hard gate. Manual rollback command for runbook:
```
/deploy rollback --session cs-1765555555-1 --to lynx-8b-stable --reason "hard_gate_2026-03-29"
```
Escalation channel: #oncall-eng for emergency.

Tanya: Moving to observe-only. Please post thumbs in thread when you approve global. Manual rollback only if auto-trigger doesn't stabilize. Will pin ladder-hash to catalog after full green.

deploy-bot: Session cs-1765555555-1 at 30m: p50=86ms, p95=184ms, errors=0.21%. No auto-rollback. Awaiting eng leads consent for global cutover.
